entries.title_en: Masked diffusion enables coherent beat tracking
entries.title_zh: 遮罩擴散讓節拍追蹤產生前後一致的輸出
entries.authors: Francesco Foscarin, Filip Korzeniowski, Richard Vogl
entries.why_zh: 把「模型為什麼會吐出自相矛盾的節拍」這個老問題重新診斷成機率建模的缺陷，而不是後處理不夠強，然後用遮罩擴散給出對症的解法。三個為節拍任務量身改造的設計細節都寫得很誠實，包含哪些嘗試失敗了。
entries.why_en: It re-diagnoses a long-standing failure of beat trackers as a probabilistic modelling defect rather than a post-processing shortfall, then answers it with masked diffusion. The three task-specific modifications are reported honestly, including the variants that did not work.

motivation.zh:
神經網路節拍追蹤器會產生「不合法」的輸出：連續兩個小節線落在相鄰拍上、速度突然倍增或減半——即使訓練資料裡從來沒有這種東西。長期以來業界的處理方式是套一層動態貝氏網路（DBN）後處理，用「每小節固定幾拍」「速度變化有限」這類硬性約束把輸出掰回合理範圍。

這篇的出發點是：DBN 治的是症狀，不是病因，而且病因從來沒被講清楚過。作者提出的假設是——問題出在單步前饋這個範式本身隱含了「給定輸入，只有唯一一個正確輸出」的假設。但節拍本來就有歧義：同一首曲子，不同聽者可能採用不同的節律層級（metrical level），數成 4/4 或數成 2/2 都說得通，而且都是風格上合理的解讀。當模型面對這種曲子時，它不是選一個解讀，而是把幾個互相競爭的解讀混在一起輸出，於是產生了任何單一詮釋下都不成立的東西。

這個診斷有個直接的推論：既然病因是「沒有建模多個合法輸出」，那真正的解法就該是一個能表達多重詮釋、並在推論時一致地選定其中一個的模型，而不是在事後用規則把混合物擦乾淨。
motivation.en:
Neural beat trackers emit invalid outputs: consecutive downbeats on adjacent beat positions, abrupt tempo doubling or halving — none of which appear in the training data. The standard remedy has been a Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN) post-processor that forces the output back into shape with hard constraints such as a fixed number of beats per bar and bounded tempo variation.

The paper's starting point is that the DBN treats symptoms, and that the underlying cause has never been articulated. Their hypothesis is that the fault lies in the single-forward-pass paradigm itself, which implicitly assumes exactly one valid output per input. Beat tracking violates that assumption: listeners may legitimately adopt different metrical levels for the same piece, and alternative beat placements are stylistically plausible. Faced with such a piece, the network does not choose an interpretation — it emits a mixture of competing ones, producing something that is coherent under none of them.

The diagnosis carries a direct implication. If the cause is a failure to model multiple valid outputs, the fix should be a model that represents several interpretations and commits to one consistently at inference, not a rule-based cleanup of the mixture after the fact.

intro.zh:
節拍與小節線追蹤已經被研究了數十年，近年的工作在架構、損失函數、資料增強、預訓練與微調上都有大量嘗試，但幾乎全部共用同一個推論範式：對每個時間框，單次前饋預測一個節拍活化值。

作者盤點了「讓模型考慮多種輸出」的既有路線與各自的代價。自迴歸模型天然能建模整段輸出的聯合分布，但實作上都有麻煩：逐框自迴歸解碼需要每框一次前饋，30 秒 50 fps 就是 1500 次，推論慢到不可用；改成 [節拍類型, 節拍時間] 的緊湊 token 化雖然避開這點，但絕對時間編碼需要大量時間 token 且無法處理長片段，相對時間編碼則在生成過程中會累積誤差。

先前工作裡只有 Gagneré 等人正面處理過多重合法輸出的問題，他們用多個預測頭去捕捉不同的階層層級——但那只用在自監督預訓練階段，微調與推論時仍然回到單頭架構，所以最終輸出照樣有這篇要解的毛病。

這篇的基底是 Beat This（Foscarin 等人），一個權重、訓練程式與資料全部開源的模型。作者沿用它的資料、增強方法、評估指標與大部分超參數，只把架構與損失改造成能配合遮罩擴散。遮罩擴散這邊則主要參照 LLaDA，理由是它在訓練與推論都用線性遮罩，實作最單純。
intro.en:
Beat and downbeat tracking has been studied for decades, with recent work exploring architectures, losses, augmentation, pre-training and fine-tuning — but nearly all of it shares one inference paradigm: a single forward pass predicting a beat activation per time frame.

The authors survey the existing routes to modelling multiple outputs and the cost of each. Autoregressive models capture the joint distribution over the full output sequence, but every implementation has a drawback. Frame-wise autoregressive decoding needs one pass per frame — 1500 passes for 30 seconds at 50 fps — which is prohibitively slow. Compact [beat-type, beat-time] tokenisation avoids that, but absolute-time encoding needs many time tokens and breaks down on longer excerpts, while relative-time encoding accumulates error during generation.

Among prior work, only Gagneré et al. confront the multiple-valid-output problem directly, using multiple heads to capture different hierarchical levels. That idea is confined to their self-supervised pre-training stage; fine-tuning and inference revert to a single head, so their predictions still exhibit the pathology this paper targets.

The base here is Beat This (Foscarin et al.), whose weights, training code and data are fully open. The authors reuse its data, augmentation, metrics and most hyperparameters, changing only what masked diffusion requires. For the diffusion side they follow LLaDA, chosen because its linear masking in both training and inference makes for the simplest implementation.

method.zh:
核心設定是遮罩擴散模型（MDM）：把節拍序列 y 視為要被逐步遮罩與還原的對象，而音訊 x 在整個前向與反向過程中始終完全可見，也就是建模條件分布而非邊際分布。推論從全遮罩序列開始，每一步做一次前饋、揭露一部分框，直到整段填滿。這樣模型可以在早期步驟先選定一個合法的詮釋，再前後一致地把剩下的填完。

作者刻意把架構改動壓到最小，好繼續沿用既有的研究成果。改動有三處：加入節拍與小節線兩張可學習的 embedding 表，詞彙為 {MASK, NO_EVENT, EVENT, PAD}，在 6 層 RoFormer 之前才加入（前端只處理音訊），並乘上 √d 放大權重，這個簡單做法在初步實驗裡就有效；把原本的 sum head 換成兩個獨立線性頭，因為 sum head 會在小節線 logit 上製造反向尖峰，單步預測時無害，但這裡遮罩排程要靠 logit 信心度決定揭露順序，被污染的信心度會出問題；把 FFN 的 GELU 換成 SwiGLU，這不是必要的，只是讓設計向現代網路對齊並順帶改善結果。

真正把通用 MDM 變成能用的節拍追蹤器的，是三個非顯而易見的設計決定：

第一，**節拍與小節線獨立遮罩**。訓練時兩個通道各自抽自己的遮罩比例與遮罩，所以某一步可能節拍遮 30%、小節線遮 80%。這是推論時基於信心度的揭露策略能正確運作的前提——因為兩個通道的信心度必須各自校準到自己的稀疏度。作者試過各種在揭露前先合併兩通道信心度的做法，也試過先揭節拍再揭小節線或反過來，全都讓效能下降。理由是有些曲子節拍比小節線好抓（節奏穩定但拍號會變），有些反過來（縹緲的音樂但和聲在小節線上變化清楚），而且小節線大約比節拍稀疏四倍，logit 量級本來就不在同一個尺度上。

第二，**平衡揭露排程**。負 logit（非事件框）天生比正 logit 更有信心，所以純粹按信心度排序會先把非事件全部揭完，造成訓練與推論的不匹配——訓練時模型看到的永遠是事件與非事件混合的脈絡。在這個設定下做迭代推論反而比單步更差。解法是每一步先計算當前遮罩框中預測的正負比例，再按這個比例把揭露預算分配給正例與負例。

第三，**步間峰值挑選**。逐框網路傾向在每個真實節拍附近產生跨數框的活化叢集。原本 Beat This 是在最後做一次 7 框滑動窗的非極大值抑制，但在迭代推論裡，相鄰的峰會被揭露成相鄰的 EVENT token——這種情況訓練資料裡從未出現過（每個事件都是單一脈衝）。作者的做法是每一步推論後就做一次峰值挑選：只要有新的 EVENT 被揭露，鄰近窗內的所有框也一併被揭露並強制設為 NO_EVENT。同時順手加上一條音樂上必然成立的規則：揭露一個小節線 EVENT 時，同位置也揭露一個節拍 EVENT。作者特別指出，這組規則遠比 DBN 少，而且對所有音樂都普遍成立。

最後還加了模型集成：對多個模型的輸出 logit 取平均後再算信心度。神經網路本來就不擅長估計機率、傾向過度自信，平均能得到較可靠的信心度。這在節拍追蹤是成熟技術，但在 MDM 文獻裡不常見，因為大模型推論成本太高——25M 參數的模型則可以接受。
method.en:
The core setup is a Masked Diffusion Model. The beat sequence y is what gets progressively masked and recovered, while the audio x stays fully visible throughout the forward and reverse processes — the model learns a conditional distribution, not a marginal one. Inference starts from a fully masked sequence and iteratively reveals frames over a handful of forward passes, so the model can commit to a valid interpretation in the early steps and then fill in the rest coherently.

Architectural changes are deliberately minimal, so prior work on architectures, losses and post-processing still applies. There are three. Two learnable embedding tables (beats, downbeats) over the vocabulary {MASK, NO_EVENT, EVENT, PAD} are added just before the 6-layer RoFormer — the frontend handles audio only — and scaled by √d, a simple trick that raises the weight of the beat input and proved effective in preliminary experiments. The original sum head is replaced by two independent linear heads, because the sum head sometimes produces inverted spikes in the downbeat logits; harmless for one-step prediction, but here the masking scheduler relies on logit confidence to order the reveals, and contaminated confidences break it. GELU in the FFN is swapped for SwiGLU — not required for the method, just alignment with modern practice that also helps results.

What actually turns a generic MDM into a working beat tracker is three non-obvious choices:

**Independent masking of the two channels.** During training each channel draws its own masking ratio and its own mask, so a step may show 30% of beat frames masked and 80% of downbeat frames masked. This is the precondition for confidence-based unmasking to work per channel at inference. The authors tried aggregating confidences across channels before deciding what to reveal, and tried revealing beats first then downbeats and vice versa; all of it lowered performance. Their explanation is that some pieces make beats easier than downbeats (stable pulse, changing time signature) and others the reverse (ethereal music with clear harmonic change at downbeats), and that downbeats are roughly four times sparser, putting the two channels' logit magnitudes on different scales.

**A balanced unmasking schedule.** Negative logits — non-event frames — are systematically more confident than positive ones, so pure confidence ordering reveals all the non-events first. That creates a train/inference mismatch, since during training the model always sees a balanced mix, and iterative inference in this regime performs worse than a single step. The fix computes the current positive-to-negative ratio among the masked predictions at each step and splits the unmasking budget accordingly.

**Peak picking between steps.** Frame-wise networks spread activation across several frames near each true beat. Beat This suppresses non-maxima within a 7-frame window once, at the end. Under iterative inference, adjacent peaks become adjacent EVENT tokens — a configuration that never occurs in training, where every event is a single impulse. So peak picking is applied after every inference step: whenever an EVENT is revealed, all frames in its proximity window are also revealed and forced to NO_EVENT. The same hook enforces one musically universal rule: revealing a downbeat EVENT also reveals a beat EVENT at that position. The authors are explicit that this is a far smaller rule set than the DBN's, and one that holds across all music.

Finally, model ensembling: output logits are averaged across models before confidence is computed. Networks estimate probabilities poorly and tend to be overconfident, and averaging yields a more reliable confidence signal. Ensembling is well established in beat tracking but rare in the MDM literature because of inference cost at scale — at 25M parameters the authors find it acceptable.

limitation.zh:
作者自己列出的代價很清楚：訓練時間加倍（150 epoch 增為 300），推論時間大約是單步的數倍——雖然他們指出前端只需算一次，還有優化空間。模型集成則讓這兩項成本再乘上模型數量。

更根本的一個限制被作者誠實地點出來：他們讓模型能在多個合法詮釋中消歧義了，但評估指標仍然假設只有一個正確答案。AMLt 部分處理了這件事（容許二分之一與二倍速），但預設設定不含三分法細分，也無法處理複雜拍號、拍號變化與本質上模稜兩可的節拍位置。換句話說，這篇最想證明的那個能力，現有指標其實測不太到。

實驗設計上也有幾點值得留意。測試集是 GTZAN，而 GTZAN 以 3 拍與 4 拍曲子為主，只有少數拍號變化——這正好是 DBN 假設成立得最好的場景，所以「不用 DBN 也能打平」這個結論在更多樣的音樂上會如何，是外推而非實測。與 SOTA 系統的比較也不是嚴格的對照：Gagneré 等人的程式與模型未公開，無法做更深入的評估或統計顯著性檢定；Ru 等人微調的是參數量十倍以上的 MusicFM。作者自己也說直接比較不是目的，只是提供脈絡。

此外，訓練超參數有一部分是被硬體逼出來的：因為 GPU 限制只能用 fp16 而非 bf16 混合精度，所以必須調低學習率、加大 weight decay、加梯度裁剪，並把遮罩比例下限 ε 設得比語言 MDM 高得多（後者約 0.001）。這些不是方法本身的需求，但確實混在結果裡。
limitation.en:
The costs the authors themselves list are clear: training time doubles (150 epochs to 300) and inference is several times slower than a single pass, though they note the frontend need only be computed once, leaving room for optimisation. Ensembling multiplies both by the number of models.

A deeper limitation is stated honestly: they have given the model the ability to disambiguate among valid interpretations, but the metrics still assume exactly one is correct. AMLt partially accommodates this by allowing half and double tempi, but its default configuration excludes ternary subdivisions and cannot handle complex time signatures, time-signature changes, or genuinely ambiguous beat positions. The capability the paper most wants to demonstrate is the one current metrics measure least well.

Several aspects of the experimental design deserve attention. The test set is GTZAN, which is dominated by pieces in 3 and 4 beats per bar with few time-signature changes — precisely the regime where the DBN's assumptions hold best. So the claim that a DBN-free system can match DBN-based ones on more diverse music is an extrapolation, not a measurement. The SOTA comparison is not a controlled one either: Gagneré et al.'s code and models are not public, precluding deeper evaluation or significance testing, and Ru et al. fine-tune MusicFM, a model more than ten times larger. The authors say directly that head-to-head comparison is not their objective and the numbers are context.

Some hyperparameters are also forced by hardware rather than by the method: GPU constraints meant fp16 rather than bf16 mixed precision, which required a lower learning rate, higher weight decay, gradient clipping, and a masking-ratio floor ε far above what language MDMs use (around 0.001). These are not requirements of the approach, but they are mixed into the results.

discussion.zh:
這篇最有價值的地方不在數字，而在它示範了一種診斷方式：當模型持續產生訓練資料裡不存在的錯誤時，先問這是不是機率建模層次的問題，而不是急著加後處理。作者提出的證據鏈很有說服力——最引人注意的是，即使只用「單步」推論，MDM 訓練目標也已經勝過非擴散版本。這代表好處不只來自迭代推論，也來自訓練目標本身；作者的假設是部分遮罩的脈絡減少了「訓練混淆」，也就是當網路看到節律層級互相衝突的相似曲目時不會被逼著平均掉。

連貫性的量化結果也具體：8 步推論下，每首曲子的連續小節線平均從 0.25 降到 0.02，速度倍增／減半事件從 0.75 降到 0.119（20 步時再降到 0.06）。作為對照，GTZAN 標註本身是 0 與 0.033。這是直接對著病因量測，而不是只看整體 F1。

更值得注意的是這個架構順帶打開的應用面。模型接受部分輸出作為輸入，這是單步系統做不到的：使用者可以先手動標定幾個節拍位置，讓模型把其餘補完，對困難曲目的標註工作是實質的加速。同樣的機制不需任何訓練修改就支援自迴歸與區塊自迴歸推論——把前一片段輸出的尾端當成永遠不遮罩的條件，就能讓長曲子在片段之間保持一致，而不是像現在這樣各段獨立處理。

作者也指出這個思路不限於節拍：和弦辨識、結構分段同樣有「多個合法輸出」的性質，可能適用同一套處理。這個推論合理，但也提醒我們這篇的貢獻主要是方法論上的可移植性，而非節拍追蹤這個任務本身的突破。
discussion.en:
The paper's most valuable contribution is not a number but a way of diagnosing: when a model persistently produces errors absent from its training data, ask first whether the fault is at the level of probabilistic modelling rather than reaching for more post-processing. The evidence is persuasive, and the striking part is that the MDM training objective beats the non-diffusion version even at a single inference step. The benefit therefore is not only from iterative inference but from the objective itself; the authors hypothesise that partially masked context reduces training "confusion" when the network sees similar pieces annotated at conflicting metrical levels.

The coherence measurements are concrete. At 8 inference steps, consecutive downbeats per track drop from 0.25 to 0.02 and tempo doubling/halving events from 0.75 to 0.119 (0.06 at 20 steps), against 0 and 0.033 in the GTZAN annotations themselves. This measures the diagnosed cause directly rather than reading it off an aggregate F1.

More notable still is what the architecture opens up. The model accepts partial outputs as input, which one-step systems cannot: a user can fix a handful of beat positions and have the model complete the rest, a real speedup for annotating difficult pieces. The same mechanism supports autoregressive and block-autoregressive inference with no training changes — conditioning on the tail of the previous snippet's output, always unmasked, would keep long pieces consistent across snippets instead of processing each independently.

The authors note the idea is not specific to beats: chord recognition and structure segmentation share the multiple-valid-output property and may admit the same treatment. That is a reasonable extrapolation, and also a reminder that the contribution here is mainly methodological portability rather than a breakthrough in beat tracking as such.

entries.title_en: Diff-Symbo: Text-Controlled Long-Duration Symbolic Music Generation Using Autoregressive Latent Diffusion Model
entries.title_zh: Diff-Symbo：用自迴歸潛在擴散模型做文字控制的長篇符號音樂生成
entries.authors: Zhiwei Lin, Jun Chen, Boshi Tang, Weihao Wu, Yang Jing, Yaolong Ju, Fan Fan, Zhiyong Wu
entries.why_zh: 把擴散模型的品質優勢與自迴歸的長度優勢接在一起，關鍵在於用前一段的潛在變數當條件而不是硬拼接。作者明確寫出了自己先試過的失敗做法與失敗原因，那段分析比最終方法更有參考價值。
entries.why_en: It joins diffusion's quality advantage to autoregression's length advantage, the key being to condition on the previous segment's latent rather than concatenating segments. The authors report the approach they tried first and why it failed, and that analysis is more instructive than the final method.

motivation.zh:
文字控制的符號音樂生成有四個彼此拉扯的要求：品質、多樣性、長度、文字可控性。作者的觀察是現有方法各自只顧得上其中一半。

Transformer 解碼器路線（MuseCoco、MMT）能靠自迴歸產生較長的音樂，但品質與多樣性輸給擴散模型。擴散模型路線（Polyffusion）在品質與多樣性上有優勢，卻只能生成固定長度——因為長度被 VAE 綁死，要生成 64 小節就得訓練一個能編碼 64 小節的 VAE，而過長的音樂會讓計算成本上升、VAE 重建品質變差。

為什麼是符號而不是波形，作者也講得直接：波形裡的音樂元素是隱含的、難以調整，這限制了實用性；符號音樂是離散音樂元素的序列，速度、音高、力度、配器都可以在高低兩個層次上精確修改。對作曲者、音樂教育者、或想做高度客製化作品的人來說，這種控制力才是關鍵。

另外一個現實障礙是資料：文字與符號音樂配對的資料集根本不足，這是這個方向「還在非常早期階段」的一部分原因。
motivation.en:
Text-controlled symbolic music generation has four requirements that pull against each other: quality, diversity, duration and text controllability. The authors observe that existing methods manage only half of them each.

The Transformer-decoder line (MuseCoco, MMT) generates longer music autoregressively but loses to diffusion on quality and diversity. The diffusion line (Polyffusion) wins on quality and diversity but produces only fixed-length output, because length is bound to the VAE: generating 64 bars requires training a VAE that encodes 64 bars, and longer spans raise compute cost while degrading reconstruction.

On why symbolic rather than waveform, the authors are direct: musical elements in a waveform are implicit and hard to adjust, which limits practical use, whereas symbolic music is a sequence of discrete elements where tempo, pitch, dynamics and instrumentation can be edited precisely at both low and high levels. For composers, educators, or anyone building highly customised work, that controllability is the point.

A second practical obstacle is data: paired text–symbolic-music datasets barely exist, which is part of why this direction remains at a very early stage.

intro.zh:
作者把相關工作分成兩條線來盤點。

文字到音訊的音樂生成已經相當成熟，典型結構有三個部件：文字編碼器（T5、CLAP、MuLan）把詞映射到潛在空間；自編碼器把波形壓成離散聲學 token（殘差向量量化）或連續聲學嵌入；聲學建模把文字嵌入轉成聲學 token。MusicGen 與 MusicLM 用自迴歸方式建模，MAGNET 用遮罩語言建模，AudioLDM 系列、Mustango、Stable Audio 系列則走擴散。

文字到符號音樂則明顯落後。BUTTER 基於 VAE 做音樂表徵解耦與跨模態對齊，能從文字生成 ABC 記譜，但描述被限制在三個確切關鍵字。GPT-4 也能生成 ABC 記譜，但缺乏任何有意義的和聲——它本來就是為理解與生成文字設計的，不是音樂。Wu 與 Sun 在超過 20 萬對文字-ABC 資料上微調，模型仍難以準確對應文字裡的音樂屬性，且只能生成單軌。MuseCoco 把任務拆成兩階段：先用 BERT 從文字預測音樂屬性，再把屬性當前綴 token 用 Transformer 解碼器自迴歸生成——能對上文字描述，但長度受限且訓練成本可觀。

擴散應用於符號音樂這一支，Mittal 等人首次把擴散用在離散符號音樂上（用 2 小節的 MusicVAE），Polyffusion 把樂譜當成鋼琴捲影像來生成，Wang 等人用級聯擴散生成整首歌。潛在擴散（LDM）則在影像、影片、音訊各領域廣泛成功。作者的定位很明確：現有 LDM 工作無法在文字條件下生成長篇符號音樂，這正是他們要補的洞。
intro.en:
The authors survey two lines of prior work.

Text-to-audio music generation is comparatively mature, typically with three components: a text encoder (T5, CLAP, MuLan) mapping words into latent space; an autoencoder compressing waveforms into discrete acoustic tokens via residual vector quantisation or into continuous embeddings; and acoustic modelling from text embeddings to acoustic tokens. MusicGen and MusicLM model autoregressively, MAGNET uses masked language modelling, and the AudioLDM series, Mustango and the Stable Audio series use diffusion.

Text-to-symbolic lags clearly behind. BUTTER disentangles music representations with a VAE and aligns them cross-modally, generating ABC notation from text, but its descriptions are limited to three exact keywords. GPT-4 can also produce ABC notation but with no meaningful harmony, having been built to understand and generate text rather than music. Wu and Sun fine-tuned on over 200k text–ABC pairs and still struggled to match the musical attributes in the text, with output limited to solo tracks. MuseCoco splits the task in two — BERT predicts musical attributes from text, then those attributes serve as prefix tokens for autoregressive decoder-only generation — which does follow text descriptions, but with limited length and considerable training cost.

On the diffusion side, Mittal et al. first applied diffusion to discrete symbolic music using a 2-bar MusicVAE, Polyffusion generates polyphonic scores treated as piano-roll images, and Wang et al. use cascaded diffusion for whole songs. Latent diffusion has succeeded broadly across image, video and audio. The authors' position is precise: no existing LDM work generates long-duration symbolic music conditioned on text, and that is the gap they target.

method.zh:
整體架構由三塊組成：音樂資訊編碼器、Multi-view MidiVAE、以及 Transformer 為骨幹的擴散模型。訓練分兩階段——先訓練 LDM 生成符合文字描述的音樂，再加入音樂脈絡模組做全參數微調，讓模型能自迴歸地生成長篇。

**資料建構。** 沒有合用的文字-符號音樂配對資料集，所以自己造。作者把音樂屬性分成客觀與主觀兩類：樂器、速度這類客觀屬性可以直接從符號音樂抽出，音域之類需要用規則計算，主觀屬性則只能取自資料集既有標籤。他們為每個音樂屬性設計單句模板，再用 GPT-4 把模板改寫成 3 到 6 句意思相同的自然語言描述，並對每一種屬性組合都做一次，最終得到涵蓋所有組合的 19,345 個文字模板。

**音樂資訊編碼器（MI Encoder）。** 預訓練 BERT 雖然能抽語意特徵，但後續擴散模型的計算成本隨文字長度平方成長。作者的做法是：凍結 BERT，加上注意力機制與 m 個可學習參數（m 是預定義音樂屬性總數）。這些 query 先過自注意力層，再作為交叉注意力層的 query，以 BERT 抽出的語意表徵當 key 與 value，最後每個 query 的輸出經 softmax 分類器去分類音樂屬性（例如有沒有「鋼琴」、拍號是多少）。用這個分類任務訓練編碼器，等於逼它把與音樂無關的語意資訊濾掉。訓練這個編碼器時可以隨機生成大量屬性組合來造文字，不必真的從 MIDI 抽屬性，資料建構更靈活。

**LDM 本體。** 用 Multi-view MidiVAE 把符號音樂編成潛在變數，骨幹採 Transformer Encoder 架構以捕捉音樂的時序動態。訓練時用 classifier-free guidance，以 20% 的固定機率丟棄文字條件，同時訓練條件與非條件 LDM。

**長度問題與失敗的第一次嘗試——這段是全文最有價值的部分。** 作者先照 Mittal 等人的做法試：把長曲切成多段、各自編碼、把潛在變數串接起來代表整首的分布。結果不理想。無條件生成把 16 小節切成兩個 8 小節時，段落之間內容明顯改變，尤其是樂器會換掉；加上文字描述當控制條件也沒能完全解決；把 32 小節切成四段時，段數增加讓突兀變化更嚴重。

作者給出的解釋是機率上的：若把樂曲切成 n 段編碼得到 n 個分布，單純串接等於要求擴散模型去擬合一個複雜的聯合新分布 p(z₁,…,z_n)；加入文字條件 c 後模型擬合的是更具體的 p(z₁,…,z_n|c)，這確實在一定程度上緩解了樂器特性捕捉的問題，但隨段數增加，整體分布的複雜度上升，去噪過程的偏差累積，問題重新惡化。他們也指出為什麼 Mittal 等人沒遇到這個問題——因為那份工作根本沒考慮樂器這類音樂資訊。

**實際採用的自迴歸做法。** 不再一次生成多段，而是一次只生成一段，靠串接延長總長度。關鍵是用音樂脈絡的內容資訊來引導新段落：對相鄰兩段 s_{i-1} 與 s_i，用 VAE 編碼器抽出潛在變數，前者作為後者的脈絡條件。實作上設計了一個音樂脈絡模組，在每個 Transformer block 裡加交叉注意力層，訓練時把前一段的潛在變數當作 key 與 value。由於 LDM 已經學會擬合 p(z|c)，這裡做全參數微調讓它改去擬合 p(z_i|c, z_{i-1})。推論時先用未微調的 LDM 生成第一段，再用微調後的模型逐段往下生成，最後把各段解碼並按時序串接。

同一個機制順帶支援音樂續寫：把既有樂曲用 VAE 編碼器取得潛在表徵當脈絡條件，再結合文字模板構造出想要的描述，就能讓模型接著寫下去。
method.en:
The architecture has three parts: a music information encoder, a Multi-view MidiVAE, and a Transformer-backbone diffusion model. Training runs in two stages — first an LDM that generates music matching a text description, then full-parameter fine-tuning with a musical context module added, enabling autoregressive long-form generation.

**Data construction.** With no suitable paired dataset, they build one. Musical attributes split into objective and subjective: instruments and tempo can be extracted directly from symbolic music, things like pitch range require rule-based computation, and subjective attributes must come from pre-existing labels. They write a single-sentence template per attribute, use GPT-4 to rewrite each into 3–6 natural-language paraphrases, and repeat for every attribute combination, yielding 19,345 templates covering all combinations.

**Music Information Encoder.** Pre-trained BERT extracts semantics, but downstream diffusion cost grows quadratically with text length. Their encoder freezes BERT and adds an attention mechanism plus m learnable queries, where m is the number of predefined musical attributes. The queries pass through self-attention, then act as queries in a cross-attention layer with BERT's representations as keys and values; each query's output is classified for a musical attribute (is "piano" present, what is the time signature) through a softmax classifier. Training on this classification task forces the encoder to strip semantics unrelated to music. Notably, training data for the encoder can be generated by randomly sampling attribute combinations and synthesising the corresponding text — no MIDI extraction required — which makes construction more flexible.

**The LDM.** Multi-view MidiVAE encodes symbolic music into a latent variable; the backbone is a Transformer Encoder chosen to capture music's temporal dynamics. Training uses classifier-free guidance, dropping the text condition with fixed probability 20% to train the conditional and unconditional models together.

**The length problem and the first attempt that failed — the most instructive part of the paper.** They first tried the Mittal et al. approach: split a long piece into segments, encode each, and concatenate the latents to represent the whole. It did not work. Unconditional generation splitting 16 bars into two 8-bar segments produced conspicuous content changes between segments, instrumentation especially. Adding text conditioning did not fully resolve it. Splitting 32 bars into four segments made the abrupt changes worse.

Their explanation is probabilistic: encoding n segments gives n distributions, and naive concatenation asks the diffusion model to fit a complex joint p(z₁,…,z_n). Text conditioning narrows this to p(z₁,…,z_n|c), which does help the model capture instrument characteristics, but as segment count grows so does the complexity of the overall distribution, bias accumulates through denoising, and the problem returns. They also explain why Mittal et al. did not hit it: that work did not consider musical information such as instrumentation at all.

**The autoregressive approach they adopt.** Rather than generating many segments at once, generate one at a time and extend by concatenation. The key is conditioning each new segment on the content of its predecessor: for adjacent segments s_{i-1} and s_i, the VAE encoder extracts latents and the former conditions the latter. A musical context module adds a cross-attention layer inside each Transformer block, taking the previous segment's latent as key and value during training. Since the LDM already fits p(z|c), full-parameter fine-tuning retargets it to p(z_i|c, z_{i-1}). At inference the un-fine-tuned LDM generates the first segment, the fine-tuned model generates each subsequent one, and the decoded segments are concatenated in temporal order.

The same mechanism supports music continuation: encode an existing piece with the VAE to obtain the context condition, construct a text description from attributes and templates, and let the model continue.

limitation.zh:
評估的規模與方法都偏薄。主觀實驗只邀請 20 位「音樂愛好者」（不是受過訓練的音樂家）以 1-5 分評分，GPT-4 那組基線更是「用官方網頁手動」以 20 條隨機測試文字生成——這種手動、小樣本、且對 GPT-4 明顯不利的設定，很難支撐嚴謹的比較。作者自己也承認基線少，因為文字到符號音樂的工作本來就不多。

消融研究相當有限。MI Encoder 那一項實際上只比較了「BERT 有沒有微調」對 ASA 的影響，並沒有真正隔離出 MI Encoder 這個設計相對於直接用 BERT 輸出的貢獻——而降低計算成本正是它被提出的主要理由之一，但論文沒有給出計算成本的實際數字。CFG 的結論是提升文字可控性但略微降低音樂品質，這與既有認識一致，沒有新資訊。

最關鍵的是，那個核心的自迴歸脈絡機制只在「相鄰兩段」的條件下訓練——微調資料是 16 小節切成兩個 8 小節、且屬性一致的片段（256,154 個）。但推論時要一路生成到 32 小節（四段）甚至更長。條件只看前一段而非全部歷史，代表這是一階馬可夫的近似；32 小節的實驗結果雖然正面，但作者沒有報告更長篇幅下一致性是否會漂移，而「幾分鐘的一致音樂」正是摘要裡的主張。

另外，訓練資料只保留「相鄰兩段屬性一致」的片段（從 224,928 個 MIDI 檔切出的片段中篩選），這等於系統性地把真實音樂裡的段落轉換、配器變化排除在訓練之外。模型學到的是保持一致，而非在該變的時候變——對於需要結構對比的長篇音樂，這可能是個內建的限制。
limitation.en:
Evaluation is thin in both scale and method. The subjective study uses 20 "music enthusiasts" — not trained musicians — rating on a 1–5 scale, and the GPT-4 baseline was produced "manually via the official web page" from 20 randomly selected test texts. A manual, small-sample setup that clearly disadvantages GPT-4 cannot support a rigorous comparison. The authors concede the baselines are few, since little prior text-to-symbolic work exists.

The ablation is limited. The MI Encoder entry actually compares only whether BERT is fine-tuned, measured by ASA; it does not isolate what the MI Encoder design contributes over using BERT's output directly — and reducing computational cost was one of its stated motivations, yet no compute figures are reported. The CFG finding, better text controllability at slight cost to quality, matches existing understanding and adds nothing new.

Most importantly, the central autoregressive context mechanism is trained only on adjacent pairs: fine-tuning data is 16-bar spans split into two 8-bar segments, filtered to those with consistent attributes (256,154 of them). Inference then runs out to 32 bars (four segments) and beyond. Conditioning on only the previous segment rather than the full history makes this a first-order Markov approximation. The 32-bar results are positive, but the paper does not report whether consistency drifts over longer spans — and "consistent music up to several minutes" is the claim in the abstract.

Relatedly, training keeps only segments whose adjacent halves share attributes, filtered from spans cut out of 224,928 MIDI files. That systematically removes sectional transitions and instrumentation changes — real features of real music — from training. The model learns to stay consistent, not to change when change is called for, which may be a built-in limitation for long-form music that needs structural contrast.

discussion.zh:
這篇的貢獻與其說是模型，不如說是一個接合方式：擴散模型的長度限制來自 VAE，而 VAE 的限制無法靠切段串接繞過——因為串接改變的是要擬合的分布本身。真正的解法是不要一次擬合聯合分布，而是把長度問題轉成逐段的條件生成問題。這個轉換乾淨且可移植。

讓這篇特別值得讀的是作者把失敗過程寫出來了。他們先試了文獻裡既有的做法（串接潛在變數）、觀察到具體症狀（段落間樂器突變）、給出機率上的解釋（分布複雜度隨段數上升、去噪偏差累積）、並解釋了為什麼前人沒遇到（前人沒建模樂器）。這條推理鏈比最終那個交叉注意力模組更有參考價值——它告訴讀者在什麼條件下前人的做法會失效。

實務上有兩點值得留意。一是 MI Encoder 的訓練資料可以完全合成——隨機組合屬性再生成對應文字，不需要真實 MIDI——這對任何缺乏配對資料的條件生成任務都是可借鑑的技巧。二是刻意在訓練時隨機選 3 到 5 個屬性、每個屬性再以 5% 機率刪掉，用來模擬使用者不會把所有屬性都寫進提示的真實情況。這種對「輸入不完整」的顯式建模，比事後才發現模型在真實輸入上崩掉要好得多。

至於「這是首個把 LDM 與脈絡學習用於多軌文字到符號音樂生成的工作」這個定位，考慮到這個子領域確實還很稀疏，作為先行工作的價值主要在於劃出可行路線，而不在於它現在的絕對效能。
discussion.en:
The contribution is less a model than a way of joining things: diffusion's length limit comes from the VAE, and that limit cannot be worked around by splitting and concatenating, because concatenation changes the distribution being fitted. The real fix is to stop fitting a joint distribution at all and recast length as segment-wise conditional generation. The reframing is clean and portable.

What makes the paper worth reading is that the authors write up the failure. They tried the existing approach (concatenated latents), observed a specific symptom (instrumentation flipping between segments), gave a probabilistic account (distribution complexity rising with segment count, denoising bias accumulating), and explained why their predecessors did not hit it (that work never modelled instrumentation). That chain of reasoning is more useful than the cross-attention module it leads to, because it tells the reader under what conditions the prior approach breaks.

Two practical points are worth carrying away. First, the MI Encoder's training data can be fully synthetic — sample attribute combinations, generate matching text, no real MIDI needed — a trick applicable to any conditional generation task short on paired data. Second, training deliberately samples 3–5 attributes and then drops each with 5% probability, simulating users who do not spell out every attribute in a prompt. Modelling incomplete input explicitly beats discovering after deployment that the model collapses on it.

As for the claim of being the first to apply LDM and contextual learning to multi-track text-to-symbolic generation: given how sparse this subfield genuinely is, the value of a pioneering work lies in marking out a viable route rather than in its absolute performance today.

entries.title_en: Towards Robust Version Identification in the Wild: A Dataset, Benchmark, and Fine-Tuning Study
entries.title_zh: 邁向真實環境下穩健的版本辨識：資料集、基準與微調研究
entries.authors: Simon Hachmeier, R. Oguz Araz, Dmitry Bogdanov, Robert Jäschke, Xavier Serra
entries.why_zh: 指出既有版本辨識資料集全部偏向專業錄音，與真實世界的業餘、使用者生成內容存在領域落差，然後用 110 萬個版本把這個落差補上。難得的是它同時報告了微調帶來的退步，而不只報告進步。
entries.why_en: It identifies a domain mismatch — every existing version-identification dataset is dominated by professional recordings, while the real world is full of amateur and user-generated content — and closes it with 1.1 million versions. Unusually, it reports where fine-tuning makes things worse, not only where it helps.

motivation.zh:
版本辨識（version identification，VI）要做的是：給一堆音軌，自動找出哪些是同一首作品的不同演繹。這包含翻唱、現場、器樂版等等。

問題出在訓練資料。現有的資料集幾乎都衍生自人工策展的線上資料庫——SecondHandSongs 與 Discogs——因此以專業錄音為主。以 Discogs-VI-YT（DVI）為例，它有將近 50 萬個版本，是目前 SOTA 系統的訓練與評估基礎，但它刻意限定在 YouTube 的官方上傳，以確保資料乾淨。

這個設計選擇的代價是：把實務上真正大量存在的東西排除掉了。非官方、使用者生成的上傳才是平台上的常態，而它們帶來的挑戰是真實的——業餘翻唱的音質參差、使用者自錄現場的環境噪音，還有更麻煩的：音樂根本不是以演出形式呈現的內容，例如反應影片、教學影片，中間穿插著解說與非音樂片段。已有研究顯示，在 SHS100K 上訓練的 VI 系統在 YouTube 上找到的各種版本上表現明顯下滑。那份研究雖然處理了部分限制，但資料集規模太小，不足以訓練 VI 系統。

所以缺口很具體：既要有真實環境的多樣性，又要有足以訓練的規模。
motivation.en:
Version identification (VI) asks which tracks in a collection are different renditions of the same musical work — covers, live performances, instrumental versions and so on.

The problem is the training data. Nearly all existing datasets derive from manually curated online collections, SecondHandSongs and Discogs, and are therefore dominated by professional recordings. Discogs-VI-YT (DVI), with nearly 500,000 versions, underpins the current state of the art, but it is deliberately restricted to official YouTube uploads to keep the data clean.

The cost of that design choice is that it excludes what actually dominates in practice. Unofficial, user-generated uploads are the norm on the platform, and they bring real difficulties: variable audio quality in amateur covers, environmental noise in user-recorded live performances, and — harder still — music presented in formats that are not performances at all, such as reaction videos and tutorials, interrupted by commentary and non-musical content. Prior work has shown that VI systems trained on the SHS-based SHS100K underperform on versions found on YouTube. That study addressed some of the limitations but its dataset was too small to train VI systems with.

So the gap is specific: real-world diversity together with enough scale to train on.

intro.zh:
VI 的技術路線近年有明顯轉向。早期方法多半使用手工設計的音訊描述子，近期則以直接從常數 Q 變換（CQT）學習緊緻表徵為主流。這類方法對資料量的需求很大，所以資料集才會集中在 SHS 與 Discogs 這些人工策展來源。

作者的做法是建立在 DVI 之上而不是另起爐灶：不新增任何作品（work），保留 DVI 原本對作品的訓練／驗證／測試劃分，只針對這些既有作品去野外尋找新的版本。他們把能從 YouTube 下載到的 96% 版本記為 DVI*，作為基礎。

這個設計決定很關鍵——它讓新資料集與既有的 Discogs-VI-YT、SHS100K、Da-TACOS 保持相容，可以直接比較，而不是製造出又一個彼此不可比的孤島。

除了版本層級的標註之外，資料集另外提供兩種自動標註：類別標籤（例如 instrumental、live）與片段層級的「有無音樂」預測。前者用來支援分層評估，因為既有研究已經顯示 VI 系統對這些屬性存在偏誤；後者則是因為這份資料預期會比 DVI* 含有更多非音樂內容。
intro.en:
The technical line in VI has shifted. Early approaches used hand-crafted audio descriptors; recent ones learn compact representations directly from the constant-Q transform. These are data-hungry, which is why datasets cluster around curated sources like SHS and Discogs.

The authors build on DVI rather than starting over: they add no new works, keep DVI's original partition of works into train, validation and test, and search only for new versions of those existing works. The 96% of versions they could download from YouTube is denoted DVI* and serves as the base.

That decision matters. It keeps the new dataset compatible with Discogs-VI-YT, SHS100K and Da-TACOS so results remain comparable, rather than producing yet another mutually incomparable island.

Beyond version-level annotation, the dataset provides two automatic labellings: categorical tags (instrumental, live and so on) and segment-level music/non-music predictions. The first supports stratified evaluation, since prior work has shown VI systems carry biases with respect to such properties; the second exists because this data is expected to contain more non-musical content than DVI*.

method.zh:
**尋找野外版本。** 以 DVI* 的作品為基礎在 YouTube 搜尋，查詢字串是正規化後的曲名（轉小寫、去除變音符號、去除開頭冠詞與標點、去掉括號內可能表示編輯資訊的文字如「Radio Edit」）。每個查詢取前 500 筆搜尋結果的 metadata。

過濾流程層層收緊：排除時長小於 10 秒的候選（因為既有研究顯示短於此長度時 VI 效能會下滑，可能是這個任務的自然最小長度），排除超過 20 分鐘的，排除 YouTube ID 已出現在 DVI、SHS100K、Da-TACOS 任一資料集中的（確保找的是新東西且維持相容性）。為了刻意偏向非官方版本，再排除符合官方版本條件的候選，以及標題含 lyric video 或 remaster 的。之後每個查詢只留前 100 個候選。

**模糊比對。** 要求 DVI* 的作品 metadata（正規化曲名、演出者名）出現在候選的 YouTube metadata（影片標題與描述）中；一個作品關聯的所有演出者名中命中任一個即可。用 Rapidfuzz 的 token ratio，門檻設在 80%。

**去重。** 為避免撈到的其實只是另一個官方版本，用建立在 Chromaprint 之上的 soundalike 系統做去重，相似度門檻 0.8，在完整音軌層級比對——也就是說兩者必須整段音訊都超過門檻才算重複。重複組內優先保留來自 DVI* 的版本。這一步丟掉 31% 的比對候選，最終得到 629,536 個新發現的版本（記為 YVI-L），與 DVI* 合併成 DiVers-L，共 1,102,317 個版本。

**品質驗證。** 人工標註 320 組隨機抽出的配對，96.25% 的指派是正確的。作者也追查了錯誤來源：多半發生在演出者正確但查詢曲名對上的其實是影片標題裡提到的專輯名，或是 DVI* 本身就有指派錯誤的版本。正確配對中有 6.82% 是近似重複——作者指出可以透過調低 soundalike 的比對時長門檻來排除，但那也可能一併排除掉有價值的案例（例如反應影片）。

**片段層級音樂偵測。** 用 PANN 做聲音事件分類，10 秒滑動窗、1 秒 hop，每段取前五個預測類別，只要有任一個屬於音樂類就標記為音樂。全資料集含 64,349 小時音樂與 2,426 小時非音樂；每軌最長音樂片段平均 194 秒，最長非音樂片段平均 15 秒。

**標籤比對。** 合併 MTG-Jamendo 與 MagnaTagATune 兩個自動標註資料集的標籤（去除 68 個重疊後得 315 個），再加入 14 個 YouTube 特有標籤，共 329 個。為提高覆蓋率，用 GPT-5 把標籤翻譯成法、德、義、葡、西五種語言並人工校對。比對只針對影片標題（使用者提供的 YouTube 標籤與描述中的標籤被發現不可靠，故忽略），且採精確比對而非模糊比對（因為翻譯已經提供了彈性），並排除出現在曲名或演出者名中的比對以聚焦於脈絡資訊。標籤品質驗證方式是對 15 個最常見標籤各標註 30 支影片、共 450 支，兩位標註者獨立標註，Cohen's κ 有報告；除了 rock、blues、solo 三個之外，幾乎所有標籤的精確率都超過 80%。

**實驗設定。** 兩條路線：從頭訓練與微調。從頭訓練的是 DVINetX——採用 DVINet+ 架構並擴容到 2070 萬參數（通道數 48→64，嵌入維度 512→1024），用三元組損失搭配困難樣本挖掘。微調的是 CLEWS（近 2 億參數），在 DiVers-S 上用 bpwr-5 策略。評估同時報告 MAP 與 NAR，後者捕捉的是超越前段排名的整體排序品質。
method.en:
**Finding versions in the wild.** Starting from DVI*'s works, they search YouTube with a normalised track title as the query — lowercased, diacritics removed, leading articles and punctuation stripped, parenthetical editing information such as "Radio Edit" removed — and retrieve metadata for the top 500 results per query.

Filtering tightens in stages: candidates shorter than 10 seconds are dropped (prior work shows VI performance falls below this length, suggesting a natural minimum for the task), as are those over 20 minutes and those whose YouTube identifiers already appear in DVI, SHS100K or Da-TACOS — keeping the search to genuinely new material and preserving compatibility. To bias towards unofficial versions, candidates meeting the criteria for an official version are excluded, as are titles containing "lyric video" or "remaster". The top 100 remaining candidates per query are kept.

**Fuzzy matching.** The work metadata from DVI* (normalised title, performer name) must appear in the candidate's YouTube title and description; matching any one of the performers associated with a work suffices. They use Rapidfuzz's token ratio with a threshold of 80%.

**Deduplication.** To avoid retrieving merely another official version, they deduplicate with a soundalike system built on Chromaprint at a similarity threshold of 0.8, applied at full-track level — two items count as duplicates only if their complete recordings exceed the threshold. Within a duplicate set, DVI* versions are retained preferentially. This drops 31% of matched candidates, yielding 629,536 newly discovered versions (YVI-L); combined with DVI* this gives DiVers-L at 1,102,317 versions.

**Quality validation.** Manual annotation of 320 randomly selected pairs finds 96.25% of assignments correct. The authors trace the errors: mostly cases where the artist is right but the queried title matches an album name mentioned in the video title, or where DVI* itself contains a wrongly assigned version. Among correct matches, 6.82% are near-duplicates — removable by lowering the soundalike matching duration, but that would also exclude interesting cases such as reaction videos.

**Segment-level music detection.** PANN performs sound event classification over 10-second sliding windows with a 1-second hop; the top five predicted classes per segment are kept, and a segment is musical if any of them is a music class. The dataset holds 64,349 hours of music and 2,426 hours of non-music; the mean longest music segment per track is 194 seconds against 15 seconds for non-music.

**Tag matching.** Tags from MTG-Jamendo and MagnaTagATune are merged (315 after removing 68 overlaps) plus 14 YouTube-specific tags, for 329 total. To widen coverage, GPT-5 translates the tags into French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Spanish, followed by manual curation. Matching targets video titles only — user-provided YouTube tags and description tags were found unreliable and are ignored — and is exact rather than fuzzy, since the translations already supply flexibility; matches falling in track titles or performer names are excluded to focus on contextual information. Tag quality is checked by annotating 30 videos for each of the 15 most frequent tags, 450 in total, by two independent annotators with a reported Cohen's κ. Precision exceeds 80% for nearly every tag except rock, blues and solo.

**Experimental setup.** Two routes: training from scratch and fine-tuning. From scratch is DVINetX, the DVINet+ architecture scaled to 20.7M parameters (channels 48→64, embedding 512→1024), trained with triplet loss and hard triplet mining. Fine-tuning targets CLEWS (nearly 200M parameters) on DiVers-S with the bpwr-5 strategy. Both MAP and NAR are reported, the latter capturing overall ranking quality beyond the top results.

limitation.zh:
作者自己揭露的最重要一點，是微調帶來的是取捨而非單純的改善。CLEWS 微調後在 YVI 資料集、SHS100K* 與 DiVers-L 上表現最佳，但在乾淨的 DVI* 上，MAP 反而低於未微調版本。嵌入空間分析給出了對應的證據：微調後 YVI 上的類間／類內距離比從 1.52 升到 1.60，DVI* 上卻從 1.72 降到 1.65。也就是說，對野外版本的可分性改善，是拿乾淨資料上的可分性換來的。

作者對此提出了部分解釋——DVI* 與 SHS100K* 的中位類別大小分別是 3 與 12，類別小的時候 MAP 對個別檢索失敗特別敏感——但這只解釋了指標的敏感度，沒有消除那個實質的退步。

從頭訓練那條線的結論也不是全面勝利。DVINetX 在 DVI* 上訓練時，在 DVI* 自己的測試子集上表現最好；改用 DiVers-S 訓練雖然在所有其他評估集上改善了 NAR，但 MAP 的增益只出現在野外子集 YVI-S 與 YVI-L 上，在 SHS100K* 與合併子集上仍略低於 DVI* 訓練的模型。要到擴大成 DiVers-L 才在兩個指標與每個評估集上都超越 DiVers-S，並且除了 DVI* 自己的測試子集外全面勝過 DVI* 訓練的模型。

資料建構本身也有幾處已知的不確定性。標籤是自動指派的「銀標籤」代理，作者明確承認仍有不確定性存在，而且標註協定只估計精確率、不估計召回率——所以我們不知道有多少該被標上 live 的影片沒被標到。solo 這個標籤的錯誤分析尤其說明了問題：有四支影片含有由其他樂器伴奏的獨奏段落，嚴格說不是純獨奏，但那些樂段確實使標籤有其道理，顯示這個類別本質上就模稜兩可。

作者在倫理聲明裡也主動指出：資料來自 YouTube 使用者生成內容，語言、曲風、演出風格的分布會受到上傳行為與平台搜尋推薦機制影響，因此在 DiVers 上訓練的模型可能繼承甚至放大這些偏誤。這個提醒對一份宣稱要「更貼近真實世界」的資料集來說特別重要——更貼近的是 YouTube 的真實世界，不等於音樂的真實世界。
limitation.en:
The most important thing the authors disclose is that fine-tuning is a trade-off, not a clean improvement. Fine-tuned CLEWS performs best on the YVI datasets, SHS100K* and DiVers-L, but on the clean DVI* its MAP falls below the un-fine-tuned model. The embedding analysis supplies the matching evidence: after fine-tuning the inter/intra-class distance ratio rises on YVI from 1.52 to 1.60 but falls on DVI* from 1.72 to 1.65. Separability on in-the-wild versions improves at the cost of separability on cleaner, cataloged ones.

The authors offer a partial explanation — median class sizes of 3 for DVI* and 12 for SHS100K*, with MAP more sensitive to individual retrieval failures when classes are small — but that explains the metric's sensitivity rather than removing the regression.

The from-scratch results are not a clean sweep either. DVINetX trained on DVI* performs best on DVI*'s own test subset. Training on DiVers-S improves NAR everywhere else, but the MAP gains are confined to the in-the-wild subsets YVI-S and YVI-L; on SHS100K* and the combined subsets, MAP stays slightly below the DVI*-trained model. Only scaling to DiVers-L improves on DiVers-S across both metrics and every evaluation set, and beats DVI* training everywhere except DVI*'s own test subset.

The dataset construction carries acknowledged uncertainty. Tags are automatically assigned silver-label proxies, and the authors state plainly that uncertainty remains; the annotation protocol estimates precision but not recall, so how many videos that should carry a "live" tag went unlabelled is unknown. The error analysis for "solo" is telling: four videos contain solo passages accompanied by other instruments, which are not strictly solo performances but where the highlighted passages nevertheless justify the tag — an inherently ambiguous category.

The ethics statement raises another point unprompted: the data is YouTube user-generated content, so the distribution of languages, genres and performance styles is shaped by upload behaviour and by the platform's search and recommendation mechanisms, and models trained on DiVers may inherit or amplify those biases. That caveat matters especially for a dataset claiming to be closer to the real world — it is closer to YouTube's real world, which is not the same as music's.

discussion.zh:
這篇的價值不在於任何架構創新——它沒有提出新模型——而在於把一個大家隱約知道但沒有量化的領域落差，做成可以訓練、可以比較的東西。「策展資料集偏向專業錄音」這件事本身不新，先前研究已經指出過；這篇的貢獻是把規模做到能真正拿來訓練，而且維持與既有資料集的相容性。

分層評估的結果比整體數字更有資訊量。微調的增益在 tutorial 這個標籤上最大且最一致，作者的解釋是這類內容噪音水準較高——含有口說段落、重複段落與不穩定的節奏；相對地 live 的改善較小且較不一致，因為候選的噪音水準本來就較低。這條「增益隨噪音程度上升」的規律，在非音樂比例的分析裡也重現：NAR 的差距隨非音樂比例加大而擴大。這比單一個平均分數更能說明微調到底改善了什麼。

有一個實務上很有用的發現容易被略過：全軌嵌入比對雖然比片段層級比對便宜得多，但微調後的 CLEWS 用全軌比對在每個非音樂比例下都能匹敵或超越用片段層級比對的未微調版本。作者的解讀是，微調帶來的穩健性有一部分來自更好的時間軸聚合能力，讓模型能在單一音軌內部消化非音樂內容與局部失真。對要部署檢索系統的人來說，這意味著查詢時的計算成本可以省下來。另外，L2 正規化對全軌嵌入有明顯幫助，對片段層級比對則幫助有限甚至偶爾有害。

還有一個對照值得記下來：DVINetX 只有 2000 萬參數，CLEWS 接近 2 億，但在 SHS-YT+ 上以 NAR 衡量，DVINetX 反而勝過 CLEWS 的各個變體。作者只用「這很值得注意」帶過，沒有深究——但這暗示在這個任務上，資料的分布可能比模型容量更關鍵。

作者對未來的建議是探索能更好地強化類間分離的方法，以及整合音訊嵌入之外的多視角訊號例如歌詞。從前面那個「改善野外、犧牲乾淨」的取捨來看，前者確實是最該解的問題。
discussion.en:
The value here is not architectural — no new model is proposed — but in turning a domain gap everyone vaguely knew about into something trainable and comparable. That curated datasets skew professional is not itself new; prior work said so. The contribution is scale sufficient for training while preserving compatibility with existing datasets.

The stratified results carry more information than the headline numbers. Fine-tuning gains are largest and most consistent for the "tutorial" tag, which the authors attribute to higher noise — spoken segments, repeated sections, variable pacing — while "live" shows smaller and less consistent improvement because candidate noise is lower there. The same pattern, gains rising with noise, recurs in the non-music-ratio analysis, where the NAR gap widens as the non-music ratio grows. That says far more about what fine-tuning actually fixed than any single average.

One practically useful finding is easy to miss: full-track embedding comparison is substantially cheaper than segment-level matching, yet fine-tuned CLEWS with full-track retrieval matches or beats the un-fine-tuned model with segment-level matching at every non-music ratio. The authors read this as the robustness gain coming partly from better aggregation along the temporal axis, letting the model absorb non-music and local distortion within a track. For anyone deploying a retrieval system, that is query-time compute saved. Relatedly, L2 normalisation helps full-track embeddings substantially but offers little and occasionally hurts for segment-level matching.

One comparison is worth recording: DVINetX has 20M parameters against CLEWS's nearly 200M, yet on SHS-YT+ measured by NAR the smaller system outperforms every CLEWS variant. The authors note this is notable and leave it there — but it hints that on this task the training distribution may matter more than model capacity.

Their suggested directions are methods that better enforce inter-class separation and multi-view signals beyond audio embeddings, such as lyrics. Given the improve-the-wild-at-the-cost-of-the-clean trade-off above, the former is indeed the problem most in need of solving.
